readme.summary: Well-structured README with excellent clarity and installation coverage across multiple package managers, but lacks concrete usage examples, configuration details, and troubleshooting guidance beyond a link to external docs.
readme.top_issue: Configuration and troubleshooting are almost entirely deferred to an external man page URL, leaving users without inline guidance for common setup issues or customization options.

injection_risks.description: The function run_server_script() executes a script with user-controlled input without proper validation or sanitization.
The function server_clear() and server_end() call run_server_script() which may lead to command injection if the script is not properly sanitized.

critical_findings: Potential command injection vulnerability in run_server_script()
Lack of input validation and sanitization
security.summary: The code has several security concerns including potential command injection vulnerabilities, lack of input validation and sanitization, and insecure default configurations.

common_complaints: Image rendering/clearing issues in kitty and other terminals
File type detection errors (lua files misidentified as JavaScript, archive extensions not recognized)
Configuration parsing failures with special characters
Terminal compatibility limitations (kitty protocol, ueberzug backends)
praise_themes: Core functionality works well when properly configured
sentiment.summary: Community shows moderate frustration with unresolved terminal integration and detection bugs; slow maintainer responsiveness with several year-old issues (2023-2024) still pending suggests potential maintenance capacity constraints or abandonment.

communication.summary: The maintainer's responses are clear, helpful, and patient. They provide technical depth and encourage new contributors.

concerns: No commits for over 7 months (last commit July 2024)

maintenance.summary: Package is abandoned with complete absence of maintenance activity, open issues, or contributor engagement for over 7 months.
